title: Drive the review-input check-during-submission tests through real concurrent checks
outcome: The review-input tests that change a check or attempt between a submission's off-lock verification and its publication run a real concurrent begin_review_input_check (or rearm) on another thread, instead of writing the Pending proof or attempt bump into StateInner from a capture stub; a failed commit of a check's Pending is covered too.
acceptance: review_input_checks_a_check_or_attempt_change_during_submission_is_refused (or its successor) starts a real freeze check through verify_review_freeze_with_runner on another thread at the point between verification and validation, and asserts the [identity-changed-during-submission] or [identity-check-pending] refusal.
A test covers a failed commit of a check's Pending: the check is refused and leaves no observation counted.
